stories.name: Netflix analyst downgrades
stories.blurb: A wave of analyst downgrades and price-target cuts on Netflix, driven by concerns over weak user engagement, sent the stock sliding.

stories.name: Netflix Q3 earnings
stories.blurb: Netflix's third-quarter earnings report shows rising revenue and advertising growth but slowing sales growth and a cut ad revenue forecast.

stories.name: Netflix layoffs
stories.blurb: Netflix is cutting about 6% of its workforce, roughly 1,000 jobs, in its biggest round of layoffs since 2022 amid weakening engagement, intensifying competition, and a depressed stock price.

stories.name: Netflix stock dip
stories.blurb: A wave of coverage debating whether Netflix's sharp stock decline is a buying opportunity or a warning sign.

past.name: Paramount Warner Bros Merger
past.blurb: Paramount Skydance is acquiring Warner Bros. Discovery in a $110 billion deal that has cleared regulatory hurdles and is moving toward completion.

past.name: Ackman Netflix reinvestment
past.blurb: Bill Ackman's Pershing Square has bought back into Netflix years after losing $400 million on the stock, calling it a dominant business that has won the streaming wars.

past.name: Big Tech Stock Selloff
past.blurb: A broad decline in major technology and communication services stocks, including Alphabet, Amazon, and Meta, is pressuring the market and raising questions about valuations.

past.name: Netflix analyst coverage
past.blurb: A collection of market and analyst headlines in which Netflix is repeatedly cited among stocks in focus.

past.name: Netflix Q2 earnings selloff
past.blurb: Netflix shares fell sharply after the company's second-quarter revenue missed expectations and its third-quarter guidance came in weaker than investors had hoped.

Deutsche Bank upgrades Netflix to Buy
Netflix names Peter Rice content chief

8.text: Phillip Securities downgraded Disney, while Morningstar maintained its $80 price target on Netflix. The articles compare analyst sentiment on the two streaming stocks.

11.text: November 26 articles report Netflix faces a 2027 margin test from higher content spending and live programming, after Q3 2026 operating margins hit 34.6% while Q4 guidance projects a decline.

10.text: Netflix cut about 1,000 jobs and fired its content chief as growth slows, and bought Radford Studio Center for $380 million. It also aired Thanksgiving NFL games and faced backlash over its FTX portrayal in "The Altruists.

5.text: Netflix shares have fallen sharply—down roughly 36% to 57% from recent peaks—even as the company reported record margins, surging profits, and a new Disney library deal. Analysts and commentators debate whether the sell-off is a buying opportunity or a warning about slower growth.

4.text: November 20: Scott Galloway predicted Netflix and Disney will blame Grand Theft Auto VI, which sold an estimated $2.36 billion in digital copies on day one, for weaker viewership.
